name: component-preview-header
goal: Keep the selected revision component screenshots above the tabs on every component screen.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Component captures stay between identity and tabs on every component tab, History and Details. Keep current-vs-commit comparison, provenance and missing-capture states; functions gain no images.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing visual checks inspect Overview only. Extend their shared responsive helper across component tabs and Details; extend workspace evidence navigation coverage without native Electron tests.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red d81875d5 at f31d98a6 proves the component screenshot is below its tabs at all three widths. The committed tests and environment are frozen before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented a shared component screenshot header in four existing UI files. Overview omits its duplicate; page/function behavior and evidence viewers are reused. Both type checks and 16 focused unit checks pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
